title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability that could…
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from an improper verification of cryptographic signatures vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass security features and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation does not require user interaction but depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
